content: For an adenoma greater than 10 mm in size, a follow-up colonoscopy is recommended. For individuals with 5 to 10 adenomas, post-polypectomy surveillance is necessary. If an adenoma exhibits villous or tubulovillous histology, further monitoring is required. Adenomas with high-grade dysplasia warrant close follow-up. Traditional serrated adenomas require post-polypectomy surveillance. Sessile serrated lesions with dysplasia necessitate additional monitoring. Serrated polyps larger than 10 mm in size should be followed up with surveillance colonoscopy. For individuals with more than 5 sessile serrated lesions, post-polypectomy surveillance is indicated. For cases involving 3 to 4 adenomas, follow-up colonoscopy is recommended. Similarly, for 3 to 4 sessile serrated lesions, surveillance is advised. In cases where no high-risk findings are identified during colonoscopy, the recommended interval for follow-up is 5 to 10 years.
